summary.name: Harvey
summary.one_liner: Harvey is an enterprise AI platform for law firms and in-house legal teams, covering document work, contract review, research, and team governance.
keywords: alternative to general chatbots for legal work
use_cases: Running client matters on a shared platform
Organizing and querying large document sets
Tracking AI usage across a law firm or legal department
Legal research and drafting with AI agents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Harvey as a platform for law firms and in-house legal teams, with separate offerings for each. Its listed modules are Spaces, a shared workspace for firms, clients and co-counsel with ethical walls; Vault, for storing thousands of documents and querying them; Contract Intelligence, for routine reviews, negotiation support and portfolio insights; Command Center, for tracking usage across teams and offices; and Research, which publishes models and benchmarks. It also mentions Harvey II, described as a more capable agent system. The page lists enterprise security controls including SAML SSO, audit logs, IP allow-listing and data lifecycle management. Usage figures on the page are vendor-stated.
notable: Spaces workspace with ethical walls for sensitive legal work
Vault for querying thousands of documents at once
Command Center for usage benchmarking across organizations
Enterprise controls: SAML SSO, audit logs, IP allow-listing
caveats: Access is by demo request; no public pricing is shown on the page
Usage and time-saving figures are vendor-reported and not independently verified on the page
